title: Random-Subspace Frank--Wolfe over Strongly Convex Sets
summary: Frank--Wolfe methods avoid projections, but over curved feasible regions the full-space linear minimization oracle (LMO) can itself become the computational bottleneck. We introduce random-subspace Frank--Wolfe (RSFW), the first Frank--Wolfe framework, to our knowledge, that replaces the ambient LMO by exact LMOs over random low-dimensional affine sections of a general feasible set, while preserving feasibility in the original space.
